title: Audio-Omni: Unified Audio Understanding and Generation Framework
summary: A comprehensive end-to-end system that unifies speech, music, and sound effects into a single model for both understanding and high-fidelity generation. It leverages a Qwen2.5-Omni backbone and a Diffusion Transformer synthesis engine to enable complex audio editing and reasoning via natural language.
research_notes: Powered by Qwen2.5-Omni; introduces AudioEdit, a large-scale dataset of over 1 million curated audio editing pairs.

evolution.summary: Officially accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026. Updated to version 2 on arXiv in April 2026 with refined benchmarks and architectural details. The project now includes the full release of the AudioEdit dataset, model weights, and inference code.
